messages.content: "John is planning to invest in a mutual fund. He is considering two scenarios. In the first scenario, he will make an initial investment of $5000 with an annual rate of return of 7% and he will not make any additional contributions. In the second scenario, he will make an initial investment of $3000 with an annual rate of return of 6% and he will make additional regular contributions of $200 every year. He wants to compare the future value of his investment after 10 years in both scenarios. Can you help him calculate the future value of his investment in both scenarios?"
